learnings.title: Shopify App Events Analytics requires released declarations, privacy-safe data and separate query proof
learnings.claim: Shopify's 2026-10-28 App Events in Analytics changelog and official guide require a released analytics_app_events declaration plus matching validated App Events before merchant ShopifyQL FROM app_events can report them. A 202 Accepted event receipt or Dev Dashboard log alone does not prove analytics availability. Event attributes are filterable for 30 days, while hourly count/sum metrics remain for up to 365 days; do not include identifying personal data or join app_events with other datasets.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY / SHOPIFY_APP_EVENTS_ANALYTICS_DECLARATION_RETENTION_GATE: Only if an authorized installed Shopify app and a real analytics consumer exist, require a released analytics_app_events declaration, matching event handle and validation, and a successful ShopifyQL FROM app_events report. Treat 202 Accepted and Dev Dashboard logs as ingestion-only. Respect 30-day attribute and 365-day hourly count/sum retention, no cross-dataset query, and never include identifying personal data. Do not deploy, emit, or claim applied_learning_ids without permission and an actual report artifact.
learnings.next_measurement: First establish whether video_shopify has an authorized installed Shopify app and an analytics consumer. If absent mark N/A and do not deploy. If present, use read-only merchant report evidence to test matching released declaration, valid event handle, 30/365-day windows, and absence of identifying attributes; capture report SHA and applied_learning_ids only when the actual consumer applies the gate.
fallback_history: No authorized app, merchant query, or scope: keep REVIEW_ONLY, do not infer event delivery or analytics availability from docs or 202 Accepted.
